blockedPolicy: Only http://127.0.0.1:8767 static shell allowed; backend chat/status/runs intercepted; all other requests aborted.

rows.finding: Representative headings, lists, tables, emphasis, fenced code, and unsafe HTML fixtures rendered without executable elements.
rows.nextAction: Keep the safe renderer covered as supported Markdown grows.
rows.limitation: This is an isolated fixture, not owner visual acceptance.

rows.finding: Raw CLI whitespace was copied byte-for-byte and the terminal rendered once in the isolated fixture.
rows.nextAction: Retain exact-copy and single-render regression coverage.
rows.limitation: No live command/provider was used.

rows.finding: Question and answer copy returned the correct text; a denied clipboard write displayed Copy failed.
rows.nextAction: Keep clipboard success and denial feedback covered.
rows.limitation: Clipboard was an isolated in-page stub.

rows.finding: Old/new dates produced separate date metadata and timestamps exposed focusable full date/time labels.
rows.nextAction: Retain local-date and accessible-time regression coverage.
rows.limitation: Timezone/owner visual acceptance remains out of scope.

rows.finding: Rendering was exercised with a long history, but this run did not assert the near-bottom follow-latest threshold or keyboard Jump to latest behavior.
rows.nextAction: Add a scroll-position fixture that proves older reading position is preserved and the latest control is keyboard usable.
rows.limitation: No follow-latest interaction was exercised; live streaming is unavailable.

rows.finding: Context-only revert removed the later message and Undo restored it; the run made no backend calls.
rows.nextAction: Add an exact-history and busy-state fixture to broaden this check.
rows.limitation: This run checked presence/absence, not byte-for-byte history or queued protection.

rows.finding: Named fork retained the selected message prefix and origin link while the parent draft remained unchanged.
rows.nextAction: Retain parent/fork provenance regression coverage.
rows.limitation: Fork revisit after reload was not separately exercised.

rows.finding: Copy link generated a chat/message-scoped URL, but exact opening plus missing and archived destination explanations were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Test opening copied links for existing, missing, and archived destinations.
rows.limitation: The isolated check only inspected the copied URL.

rows.finding: The additional picker rendered ten choices and replacement/clearing worked, but search/navigation and close-without-message-movement were not tested.
rows.nextAction: Exercise picker keyboard navigation, search, dismissal, and scroll stability.
rows.limitation: No search or keyboard-navigation assertion.

rows.finding: Archive hid the composer; restore persisted and reload reopened the original chat with its composer.
rows.nextAction: Retain archive/restore reload coverage.
rows.limitation: This run did not inspect archived evidence content separately.

rows.finding: Workspace export downloaded valid Aven JSON containing the selected Main chat.
rows.nextAction: Add a selected-conversation Markdown/evidence export assertion.
rows.limitation: Only workspace JSON export was exercised.

rows.finding: Invalid JSON import was rejected without opening a preview; valid restore merge and unrelated-work preservation were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Run valid Add and Replace imports with collision and unrelated-chat fixtures, including recovery.
rows.limitation: Only the invalid-input path was freshly tested.

rows.finding: Cross-device history remains explicitly deferred pending identity and ownership contracts.
rows.nextAction: Revisit after account/customer isolation contract exists.
rows.limitation: No cross-device service exists in this build.

rows.finding: Avatar choices rendered and one selection saved, but migration compatibility and reload persistence were not asserted in this run.
rows.nextAction: Exercise legacy avatar migration and reload every avatar choice.
rows.limitation: No migration/reload assertion in this child audit.

rows.finding: Profile rename updated the selected coworker, but long-name readability and selected-coworker isolation were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Test long labels and rename isolation across two coworkers.
rows.limitation: Only a short rename on the seeded coworker was tested.

rows.finding: Local SOUL/MEMORY scope text and editor surface are present, but this audit did not connect saved content to a model request.
rows.nextAction: Trace a saved document through a mocked request and prove scope and exact content.
rows.limitation: Provider/model path intentionally unavailable.

rows.finding: A notification preference control is present, but completion, waiting, and error delivery/link behavior was not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Exercise muted and enabled completion/waiting/error events and verify the linked message/run.
rows.limitation: No alert/event delivery assertion in this child audit.

rows.finding: Profile editing was exercised, while coworker creation and first-welcome delivery were not duplicated in this audit.
rows.nextAction: Use the root-owned isolated creation failure evidence and add a transactional success/failure regression.
rows.limitation: Creation path intentionally left to root to avoid duplicate storage-failure mutation.

rows.finding: Compact density persisted and controls remained readable, but both light and dark themes were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Run both theme modes through save, cancel, reload, and storage failure.
rows.limitation: Only density/one appearance path was tested.

rows.finding: Settings reports the fixed runtime and avoids cosmetic provider switching, but no provider setup/test path was exercised.
rows.nextAction: Add explicit connected/tested/unavailable states with secure credential handling.
rows.limitation: Real provider calls and credentials are intentionally excluded.

rows.finding: Local configuration/status snapshot code is present, while reachability and live provider/device refresh were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Verify disconnected, refresh, timestamp, and recovery states against adapters.
rows.limitation: Real provider/device health is intentionally unavailable.

rows.finding: Privacy/data copy exists in the settings implementation, but this child audit did not open the privacy category or verify scope text.
rows.nextAction: Open privacy controls and verify local/transmitted/export/reset scope and recovery claims.
rows.limitation: No fresh privacy UI assertion.

rows.finding: Account/sign-out remains a local placeholder and is explicitly deferred.
rows.nextAction: Revisit with an authenticated account contract.
rows.limitation: No remote identity is connected.

rows.finding: Help opened keyboard/local-workspace guidance and feedback saved locally with explicit status.
rows.nextAction: Retain help and local-feedback regression coverage.
rows.limitation: No network submission was attempted.

rows.finding: The command palette opened and returned a search result, but Ctrl/Cmd+K and Ctrl/Cmd+F bindings and unavailable-action filtering were not asserted.
rows.nextAction: Exercise the documented shortcut keys and verify command registry filtering.
rows.limitation: No direct keyboard shortcut assertions.

rows.finding: Artifact library duplicates one raw output when the same diagnostic is present in both serialized events and evidence.
rows.nextAction: Deduplicate artifact outputs by stable provenance/content key across events and evidence.
rows.limitation: Reproduction uses a synthetic persisted run; no provider/device call.

rows.finding: Browser pane truthfully reported no connected browser session under the isolated blocked-provider policy.
rows.nextAction: Connect a real bounded browser adapter before claiming live preview.
rows.limitation: Live browser content/navigation was unavailable by policy.

rows.finding: Computer pane truthfully reported no connected computer session under the isolated blocked-device policy.
rows.nextAction: Connect an authorized computer adapter before claiming live control.
rows.limitation: Live screen/control was unavailable by policy.

rows.finding: Keyboard pane resize clamped to 320px and panes opened, but width persistence and close-focus restoration were not asserted.
rows.nextAction: Resize, reload, reopen, and verify focus returns to the opener.
rows.limitation: Single-session resize/close coverage only.

rows.finding: Session-scoped text file editor contains exact review/save/conflict checks; real OS picker and external disk scope remain unverified.
rows.nextAction: Exercise with a real user-selected folder under owner-controlled QA.
rows.limitation: No user disk writes were performed.

rows.finding: Aven exposes retained raw diagnostic output but no general interactive terminal surface.
rows.nextAction: Define authorized shell/session boundaries before adding terminal.
rows.limitation: Intentional scope gap.

rows.finding: Local file review is implemented; network configuration impact/rollback and execution approval remain absent.
rows.nextAction: Integrate exact network target/diff/impact and approval receipt flow.
rows.limitation: No network configuration calls were made.

rows.finding: An annotation saved with message evidence identity and persisted locally, but stale-result rejection, discard, and failed-save draft retention were not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Run stale, discard, and save-failure fixtures and verify append-only identity binding.
rows.limitation: Only the successful save path was freshly tested.

rows.finding: Digest-bound approval adapters exist outside the Aven UI; no integrated general approval receipt control is exposed.
rows.nextAction: Integrate receipt UI only after future network write scope is defined.
rows.limitation: No execution or provider calls.

rows.finding: No Git stage, commit, or PR control is present in the Aven shell.
rows.nextAction: Defer until configuration-as-code becomes a primary workflow.
rows.limitation: No Git operation was attempted.

rows.finding: Backend inventory and diagnostics pane are present, but the composer has no exact device selection control.
rows.nextAction: Expose selected device IDs/connection state before diagnostics.
rows.limitation: Inventory route was mocked and no device call was made.

rows.finding: Read-only and Plan scope text were visible; Plan exposed no tools and nested FAILURE remained a failure outcome.
rows.nextAction: Keep scope labels tied to runtime capability state.
rows.limitation: No live device call or enforcement backend was used.

rows.finding: Raw diagnostic metadata rendered the command, target, result, and run provenance for an isolated FAILURE fixture.
rows.nextAction: Retain exact provenance regression coverage.
rows.limitation: No live device evidence.

rows.finding: Nested diagnostic FAILURE overrode top-level SUCCESS and the UI stated that command completion does not establish device health.
rows.nextAction: Retain outcome/health separation coverage.
rows.limitation: The device health conclusion is fixture-driven.
